title: 工作与服务词汇
goal: 能理解工作与服务词汇并区分事务状态。

points.label: 辨认工作与服务场景词汇
区分申请、安排和完成等状态

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲
sources.used: 课程内容依据的考试大纲

body.p: 工作与服务对话谈的是人员、职责和安排。动词的时态和宾语说明一件事处在哪个阶段：申请、确认还是完成。

body.box:
A: Has the applicant accepted the offer?
B: Not yet. The company sent it yesterday.

body.p: sent the offer 表示公司已发出录用通知。not yet 表示应聘者尚未接受。

cards.title: 招聘与职责
rows: apply for a position; A: Did Sam request the job? B: Yes, Sam applied for it.
interview an applicant; A: Who is waiting? B: An applicant for the position.
fill a vacancy; A: Is a job available? B: Yes, there's a vacancy.
recruit staff; A: Is the firm hiring? B: Yes, it's recruiting staff.
interview a candidate; A: What happens tomorrow? B: We'll interview the candidate.
accept an offer; A: Has the applicant accepted? B: Yes, she accepted the offer.
hire an assistant; A: Is the position filled? B: Yes, we hired an assistant.
have responsibility for scheduling; A: Who handles schedules? B: That's my responsibility.
meet a deadline; A: When must the form arrive? B: The deadline is Friday.
supervise a team; A: Who manages the team? B: Pat supervises it.
cards.note: apply for 的对象是职位；hire 的对象是受雇的人。

cards.title: 培训与晋升
rows: attend training; A: Where is Lee today? B: She's attending training.
attend an orientation; A: What is the first session? B: An orientation for new staff.
support a trainee; A: Who is learning the system? B: The trainee.
meet a mentor; A: Who advises the new worker? B: A mentor.
develop a skill; A: What is the workshop for? B: Developing presentation skills.
attend a workshop; A: Is there practical training? B: Yes, a workshop on Tuesday.
receive an evaluation; A: What follows the review? B: A written evaluation.
receive a promotion; A: Is Dana moving to a senior role? B: Yes, she received a promotion.
obtain a qualification; A: What does the course award? B: A professional qualification.
gain experience; A: Why join the project? B: To gain experience.
cards.note: training 是培训过程；promotion 是职位上的晋升。

cards.title: 客户服务
rows: file a complaint; A: Why did the customer call? B: To file a complaint.
answer an inquiry; A: What is this message? B: An inquiry about delivery.
issue a refund; A: Was the payment returned? B: Yes, we issued a refund.
send a replacement; A: What will replace the damaged item? B: We'll send a replacement.
show a receipt; A: What proves the purchase? B: The receipt.
check the warranty; A: Is the repair covered? B: Let's check the warranty.
resolve a complaint; A: Has the complaint been settled? B: Yes, we resolved it.
schedule a delivery; A: When will the item arrive? B: The delivery is scheduled for Tuesday.
report a delay; A: Why is the package late? B: There was a delivery delay.
confirm an order; A: Is the order definite? B: Yes, we've confirmed it.
cards.note: refund 是退还款项；replacement 是替换商品。

cards.title: 出行与预订
rows: make a reservation; A: Is the room booked? B: Yes, I made a reservation.
book a seat; A: Is there a seat for me? B: I've booked one.
cancel a booking; A: Is the booking still active? B: No, I canceled it.
reschedule a trip; A: Is the trip still on Monday? B: No, we rescheduled it.
an available seat; A: Can I reserve a seat? B: One is available.
check an itinerary; A: Where are the travel details? B: In the itinerary.
check the departure time; A: When does the train leave? B: Check its departure time.
confirm the arrival time; A: When does the train reach the station? B: I'll confirm its arrival time.
pay a fare; A: What is the cost of the ride? B: The fare is twelve dollars.
make a transfer; A: Is the journey direct? B: No, there's a transfer.
cards.note: book 表示预订，cancel 表示取消已有预订。

items.stem: A company recruits staff for a vacancy. What is it doing?
options: Training staff already in the position
Looking for people to fill a position
Keeping the position unfilled for now
Moving current staff out of the position
items.why: recruit staff 是招聘人员，for a vacancy 说明要填补空缺职位，即第二项。

items.stem: An applicant has applied for a job but has not been hired. What is the status?
options: The applicant is awaiting a hiring decision.
The applicant has been hired for the job.
The applicant has not applied for the job yet.
The applicant has accepted the job offer.
items.why: applied for a job 表示已经申请，has not been hired 表示还没有被录用。申请人在等结果，即第一项。

items.stem: A customer asks for a replacement for a damaged item. What does the customer request?
options: A refund for the damaged item
A repair of the damaged item
Another item to take its place
A warranty check on the damaged item
items.why: replacement 是用来替换受损商品的另一件物品，即第三项。第一项的 refund 是退款，不是换货。

items.stem: A traveler cancels a hotel reservation. What happens to the booking?
options: It is confirmed for a new date.
It is transferred to another guest.
It remains active until arrival.
It is no longer held for the guest.
items.why: cancels a reservation 表示取消预订，房间不再为客人保留，即第四项。

items.stem: A new employee attends an orientation. What is the session for?
options: Evaluating the new employee's first month
Introducing the workplace to new staff
Interviewing the employee before hiring
Promoting the employee to a new role
items.why: orientation 是面向新员工的入职介绍，即第二项。

items.stem: A passenger reschedules a trip. What has changed?
options: The trip has been given a different time.
The fare for the trip has been returned in full.
The trip has been canceled entirely.
The journey has already been completed.
items.why: reschedule a trip 是把行程改到另一个时间，即第一项。第三项的 canceled 是取消，行程不再进行。

lines.text: I applied for the assistant position last week. Has the company made a decision?
The interviews are scheduled for Thursday, so no one has been hired yet. We'll contact each applicant after the interviews.

items.stem: What has the applicant done?
options: Accepted an offer from the company
Applied for the assistant position
Completed the Thursday interview
Started work as an assistant
items.why: I applied for the assistant position 表示已申请职位。

items.stem: What will the company do after the interviews?
options: Open a new assistant vacancy
Cancel every application received
Contact each applicant
Schedule interviews for Thursday
items.why: We'll contact each applicant after the interviews 给出面试后的安排。

lines.text: I'd like a refund for the damaged kettle. I have the receipt here. Can you return the payment today?
I'll check the receipt first. If the purchase qualifies, we can issue the refund to the same card. The payment hasn't been returned yet.

items.stem: What has the customer requested?
options: A replacement for the damaged kettle
A copy of the kettle receipt
A repair of the damaged kettle
A return of the kettle payment
items.why: 依据是 I'd like a refund for the damaged kettle，refund 是退还款项，即第四项。第一项的 replacement 是换一件商品。

items.stem: What is the current status of the payment?
options: It has not yet been returned.
It was returned to the card today.
It has been used for a replacement.
It was canceled before the purchase.
items.why: The payment hasn't been returned yet 明确表示退款尚未完成。

lines.text: Is the workshop booking confirmed for Tuesday? I need to tell the new trainees when to attend.
I've requested the room, but the office hasn't confirmed it. I'll let the trainees know once the booking is confirmed.

items.stem: What has the second speaker done with the room?
options: Canceled a confirmed reservation
Requested the room for the workshop
Completed training in the room
Confirmed the booking with the trainees
items.why: I've requested the room 表示已经提出场地申请。

items.stem: When will the trainees be notified?
options: Before the room is requested
After the workshop is completed
Once the booking is confirmed
When the Tuesday session is canceled
items.why: once the booking is confirmed 表示确认预订后通知受训人员。

items.stem: A manager supervises a team. What is the manager's role?
options: Applying for a place on the team
Overseeing the team's daily work
Training as a member of the team
Attending an interview with the team
items.why: supervise a team 是监督管理团队的工作，即第二项。

items.stem: An applicant has received an offer but has not accepted it. What is the status?
options: The offer awaits the applicant's answer.
The applicant has already accepted the offer.
The company has not sent an offer yet.
The applicant has started the new job.
items.why: received an offer 表示已经收到录用通知，has not accepted 表示还没有接受。录用通知在等申请人答复，即第一项。

items.stem: A traveler checks the departure time. Which information is being checked?
options: When the service will reach its destination
When the traveler should book the trip
When the traveler changes to another service
When the service is scheduled to leave
items.why: departure time 是出发时间，即第四项。第一项说的是到达时间 arrival time。

items.stem: A customer has requested a replacement, and the store will send it tomorrow. What is its status?
options: The replacement has already arrived.
The replacement request was canceled.
The replacement has yet to be sent.
The replacement has been returned.
items.why: will send it tomorrow 表示替换品尚未寄出。

items.stem: A worker receives a promotion. What has happened?
options: The worker has started job training.
The worker has moved up to a higher position.
The worker has been hired for the first time.
The worker has received a written evaluation.
items.why: promotion 是职位上的晋升，即第二项。

items.stem: A hotel confirms a reservation for Monday. What is the booking's status?
options: The hotel has accepted the booking.
The hotel has canceled the booking.
The guest has completed the stay.
The guest has requested another date.
items.why: confirms a reservation 表示酒店已确认预订。

lines.text: I sent my application for the design vacancy on Monday. Has the hiring team selected anyone yet?
We're still reviewing applications. Interviews will be held next week, and we'll make an offer afterward. No candidate has been hired so far.

items.stem: What is the hiring team doing now?
options: Making an offer to the selected candidate
Conducting interviews for the vacancy
Starting orientation for the new hire
Reviewing the applications received
items.why: We're still reviewing applications 表示正在审阅申请。

items.stem: What does the company plan to do after the interviews?
options: Request applications for a vacancy
Make an offer to a candidate
Hold a second round of interviews
Cancel the design position
items.why: 依据是 we'll make an offer afterward，面试之后发出录用通知，即第二项。

lines.text: I booked a train for Thursday, but the meeting has moved to Friday. Can I change my reservation?
Yes, there is a seat on Friday. I've requested the change, but it won't be confirmed until the fare difference is paid. Your Thursday booking is still active for now.

items.stem: What is the status of the requested change?
options: It has been confirmed and paid for.
It has been canceled by the traveler.
It is awaiting payment and confirmation.
It is complete because a seat is available.
items.why: won't be confirmed until the fare difference is paid 表明仍待支付和确认。

items.stem: Which booking remains active for now?
options: The existing Thursday reservation
The requested Friday reservation
The Friday meeting room booking
The canceled Thursday meeting
items.why: Your Thursday booking is still active 表明原周四预订仍有效。
